summary: This Dockerfile creates a container image based on Node.js that installs the Bruno CLI tool globally and sets it up so the container runs Bruno commands by default when started.

explanations.1: We're starting from an official Node.js image (LTS version on Debian Bookworm slim) which gives us Node and npm already installed in the container.
explanations.3: We use npm (Node's package manager) to install the Bruno CLI tool globally with the -g flag, so it's available as a command anywhere in the container.
explanations.4: ENTRYPOINT sets 'bru' as the main executable that always runs when the container starts, no matter what arguments are passed.
explanations.5: CMD provides default arguments ('run') that get passed to the ENTRYPOINT if the user doesn't override them when starting the container.
